label: About
title: About Coils Through the Red Slash
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @trojan_norse: David Hockney. Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Coils Through the Red Slash: Green coils and red slashes on raw paper: an asymmetric weave-and-clearing composition, flat frontal print plate with the vertical fold seam held left of center. Three oversized emerald serpentine loops knot through a fanned cluster of four vermilion diagonal bands, the lowest band dragging into feathered dry-brush... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Lower vermilion diagonal band fraying into dry-brush bristle streaks.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
